title: Store Center Hub Data Visibility & UI Cleanup
summary_context: Fixed data visibility in Store Center Hub by refactoring the requests API to handle Drizzle ORM syntax correctly and using in-memory filtering. Removed redundant 'Projects' tab from Store Center UI. Fixed ReferenceError by properly returning data from useCenterRequests hook.
achievements: Fixed TypeError: db.select(...).where is not a function in API.
Resolved ReferenceError: data is not defined in UI.
Removed redundant Project Management tab from Store Center.
Improved API resilience with fetchInChunks helper refactoring.
Implemented Error Banner in CenterDashboard for better diagnostics.
